Advanced Search Tools

Advanced Search

Find PDB structures and Computed Structure Models (CSM) by combining queries from tools in this suite: Attribute Search, Sequence Similarity, Sequence Motif, 3D Similarity, and 3D Motif with 'AND' logic.

Sequence Similarity Search

Find structures that contain a similar nucleotide or protein sequence using the MMseqs2 method.

Chemical Search

Find small molecules by combining queries from the tools in this suite: Chemical Attributes and Chemical Similarity Search with 'AND' logic.

Browse Annotations

Find PDB structures using annotations from various ontologies and hierarchical classification schemes, e.g. Disease Ontology, Molecular Function.

Advanced Search

Find PDB structures and Computed Structure Models (CSM) by combining queries from tools in this suite: Attribute Search, Sequence Similarity, Sequence Motif, 3D Similarity, and 3D Motif with 'AND' logic.

Sequence Similarity Search

Find structures that contain a similar nucleotide or protein sequence using the MMseqs2 method.

Chemical Search

Browse Annotations

RCSB Protein Data Bank Home Page

RCSB Protein Data Bank (RCSB PDB) enables scientific breakthroughs via TOOLS for searching, visualization, and analysis of 3D structural DATA.

RCSB PDB is a member of the Worldwide PDB partnership.

Tools

All Tools

Sequence Annotations in 3D

Map protein sequence features onto the 3D structure of protein assemblies

Sequence Similarity Search

Find structures that contain a similar nucleotide or protein sequence using the MMseqs2 method

Sequence Annotations Viewer

Graphical summaries of protein features and their relationships with UniProtKB entries

Chemical Similarity

Search for small molecules using SMILES, InChI, or chemical formula

Sequence Motif Search

Find structures with sequences that share small conserved regions (motifs) that have biological meaning

3D Similarity Search

Find structures that share a similar 3D shape using AI/ML-generated vector embeddings

Structure Attributes Search

Use structural properties that have text or numerical values to build complex queries with 'AND/OR' logic

Genome View

Explore the correspondences between PDB entity sequences, genes, and genomes

Browse Annotations

Find PDB structures using annotations from various ontologies and hierarchical classification schemes, e.g. Disease Ontology, Molecular Function

3D Motif Search

Find structures that contain a similar 3D arrangement of residues with functional significance (catalytic or binding sites)

Pairwise Structure Alignment

Calculate pairwise structure alignments using various methods

11/17/2026

Harmonization of NMR Data Deposition: Adoption of unified NMR data and PDBx/mmCIF

Starting February 2027, OneDep will accept NMR experimental data only as a single combined file in STAR or NEF format, deprecating the use of software specific file uploads.

11/15/2026

Nov 17: WHO's Cervical Cancer Elimination Day of Action

Visit PDB-101 to learn how the capsid protein of papillomavirus is used in vaccines that prevent cervical cancer

11/10/2026

Watch the Webinar: CodeBMB for Beginners

Visit PDB-101 for an introduction to coding, Google Colab, GitHub, and Python scripting fundamentals.

11/03/2026

Explore Molecular Machinery

Take a Tour of the Protein Data Bank that illustrates the beauty and diversity of PDB molecular shapes and sizes

10/27/2026

Watch the Virtual Office Hour on Biological Assemblies

Ever wondered about the difference between an asymmetric unit and a biological assembly? Learn how to access these data from RCSB.org

10/16/2026

Register for Special Webinar Celebrating PDB55

Join us on Oct 20 for a replay of the IUCr Plenary Presentation from Cynthia Wolberger (Johns Hopkins) From mechanism to inhibitors: Controlling deubiquitinating enzymes in cells

10/16/2026

Register for Electron Microscopy on PDB’s 55th Birthday

Join Jason Kaelber (Rutgers University) on Oct 20 for a webinar on Where will we be at 55 years of EM depositions?

10/16/2026

Happy Birthday, Irving Geis

Celebrate Geis' birthday (October 18, 1908) with a tour of the Geis Digital Archive of his pioneering works of biomolecular art at PDB-101

Celebrate PDB55 with IUCr and Stephanie A. Wankowicz

Watch "Decoding conformational ensembles to leverage entropy for function and design"

10/14/2026

Celebrate PDB55 with IUCr and Yifan Cheng

Watch "Making sense of invisible density in single particle cryo-EM"

homepage.title: RCSB PDB: Homepage

meta.description: As a member of the wwPDB, the RCSB PDB curates and annotates PDB data according to agreed upon standards. The RCSB PDB also provides a variety of tools and resources. Users can perform simple and advanced searches based on annotations relating to sequence, structure and function. These molecules are visualized, downloaded, and analyzed by users who range from students to specialized scientists.
